text:
2014 FIFA World Cup no san baa Brazil, ɔman a ɛyɛ honam mu fie a ɛwɔ agorɔ no mu, ɛhɔ na teams 32 hyiae fi 12 June kɔsi 13 July 2014. Nhyehyɛe no de group stage a ɛwɔ groups anan anan a wɔyɛ eight no ne single-elimination knockout phase a ɛkɔ round of 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals, third-place play-off ne final no bɔɔ mu. Wɔ matches 64 mu no, tournament no nyaa attendance a ɛyɛ 3,429,873, average 53,592 per match.

Competition no twaa n’ani kɛseɛ firii nea wɔhwehwɛe no mu. Spain a wɔyɛ defending champions no, wɔtwaa wɔn firii group stage mu, na ɛno na ɛwiei ne berɛ a ɛde wɔn kɔɔ title a edi kan no. Brazil a ɛyɛ host nation no nso, wɔn campaign no hwiei fam kɛseɛ: Germany twaa Brazil 7–1 wɔ semi-final mu, ɛyɛ one of the most lopsided results wɔ World Cup history mu, na Brazil kɔɔ n’akyi wiei wɔ fourth, wɔ Netherlands a ɛyɛ third no akyi.

Result no de Germany kɔɔ final a ɛne Argentina wɔ Maracanã Stadium wɔ Rio de Janeiro. Match no wiei wɔ extra time mu, ɛberɛ a substitute Mario Götze de ne nan bɔɔ no wɔ 113th minute no, na ɛyɛ 1–0. Ɛno na ɛma no bɛyɛɛ the first substitute a ɔbɔɔ winning goal wɔ World Cup final mu. Germany bɛyɛɛ champions mprenu a ɛdi kan, na wɔde trophy no maa wɔn bɛyɛɛ the first European team a ɛdi World Cup a ɛwɔ Americas no—the third consecutive title ma European nation a ɛdi Italy wɔ 2006 ne Spain wɔ 2010 akyi.

Individual honours no kɔɔ aman ahodoɔ so. Colombia’s James Rodríguez nyaa Golden Boot sɛ top scorer a ɔwɔ goals six, na ne volley a ɔbɔɔ Uruguay no nso nyaa FIFA Puskás Award sɛ goal of the year; Germany’s Thomas Müller wiei wɔ scoring race no mu wɔ goals five. Lionel Messi a ɔfiri Argentina a ɛyɛ runners-up no, wɔfrɛɛ no best player, na ɔnyaa adidas Golden Ball. Tournament no nso daa technical firsts two adi: ɛyɛ World Cup a edi kan a wɔde goal-line technology, na ɛyɛ the first a wɔde vanishing spray ma free kicks.
